newsitem.title: UK: HSBC lost 40 mln stg in HK underwriting.
newsitem.headline: HSBC lost 40 mln stg in HK underwriting.

text.p: HSBC Holdings lost around 40 million stg as a result of an underwriting misjudgment at its HongkongBank's investment banking unit, HSBC chairman Sir William Purves said on Monday.
Earlier, Purves had declined to quantify the loss but revealed the figure to reporters at a news conference.
Purves had said the loss had led to a flat result in HongkongBank which made an attributable profit of 815 million stg in the first half compared to 818 million stg in the first half last year.
Purves said the loss was made in one equity underwriting.
"From time to time underwritings go wrong," Purves said. "They misjudged the marketplace."
Purves said the loss was made in the normal course of business and was not due to any "untoward activity".
